criteria.description: Overlay shell reaches every documented state: toggle open/close at desktop tablet and mobile, Escape close, outside close, destination close, JS-disabled exposure of the tree; no hover-open menu and no dropdown interactions
Exactly one brand, one permanent bar CTA, one named toggle, eight title-only destinations, one contact footer action, five social destinations, zero chevrons, one landmark tree
All widths: permanent bar logo-left / CTA+toggle-right; open overlay full-width below bar with large link grid and footer row; closed bar does not show the eight destinations
Codex reviewed fresh desktop and mobile captures against the reference brief
